selection_rule: Use replicate 03 from the same JJJ-25, PRD-75, and CY-150 strata as H4. No result from these three instances has been used by the current genuine-HGS route-pool candidate.
candidate: Frozen H4 MV-HGS-SP: three genuine HGS views, complete-model elite selection, and exact route-pool recombination.
control: Best exact full-model parent produced by the same HGS views and elite pools.
gate: All cases must remain feasible and non-worsening. At least two of the three fresh cases must strictly improve over their best exact parent.
no_rescue: Do not change algorithm, cases, seed, HGS time, elite count, archive limit, or SP time.
Do not inspect further China81 instances if the gate fails.
One seed group is directional confirmation, not formal statistical evidence.
claim_boundary: Fresh replicate-03 cases and one seed. Passing freezes the architecture and permits multi-seed confirmation, not a full China81 claim.
